xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DisclosureOfNotesOnFinancialRe:
Notes
1. The above unaudited consolidated financial results of Vodafone Idea Limited, its subsidiaries (the Group) and
associates, as reviewed by the Audit Committee of the Board, were approved and taken on record by the Board of
Directors at their meeting held on November 12, 2026.
2. The Group has incurred loss of Rs. 9,729 Cr for the six months ended September 30, 2026 and the group’s net
worth stands at negative Rs. 44,298 Cr as at that date.
- As at September 30, 2026, the Group’s outstanding debt from banks, non-convertible debenture and others
(including interest accrued but not due) is Rs. 4,543 Cr and instalments payable, as scheduled, by September
2027 is Rs. 3,108 Cr and interest thereon.
- As at September 30, 2026, Deferred payment obligation (including interest accrued but not due) of
Rs. 131,268 Cr towards Spectrum and Rs. 26,264 Cr towards AGR. The instalments payable against these
deferred payment obligations, as scheduled by September 2027 is Rs. 9,216 Cr.
- As of date, the Group has met all its debt obligations payable to its lenders / banks and financial institutions
along with applicable interest. The Group is in discussion with banks to raise additional funds as required.
The Group is confident of generating sufficient cash flow from operations to meet its obligations including
spectrum, non-convertible debenture and other dues payable over the next 12 months as and when they fall due.
Accordingly, these consolidated financial results have been prepared on a going concern basis.
3. The Group operates only in one reportable segment i.e. Mobility and hence no separate disclosure is required for
segments.

For and on behalf of the Board of Directors of
VODAFONE IDEA LIMITED
Kumar Mangalam Birla
Non-Executive Chairman

Date: November 12, 2026
Place: Mumbai
